### workspace inbox --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox add TITLE [options] [scope]
       workspace inbox add --from-json PATH|- [--json]
       workspace inbox done|dismiss --dedupe-key KEY [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox list [--state S[,S]] [--type T] [--all] [--include-derived] [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox show ID [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox edit ID [options] [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox done|dismiss|reopen ID... [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox snooze ID... (--until ISO | --for DURATION) [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox ack DERIVED_ID... [scope] [--json]

A durable list of things that need a person, kept per workspace, per
project (all worktrees of one repository) or globally. Agents, scripts
and outside tools post to it; titles and bodies are data, never run.

Subcommands:
  add TITLE     Add an item (type todo unless --type says otherwise)
  list          Open items of this workspace, its project and the global list
  show ID       One item, in any state
  edit ID       Change an item's title, body, expiry or links (any state; it stays as it is)
  done ID...    Mark items done; one already done is reported unchanged
  dismiss ID... Mark items dismissed (nobody will act on them)
  reopen ID...  Move done, dismissed or snoozed items back to open
  snooze ID...  Hide open items until a time; they read open again after it. A derived id
                (from list --include-derived) is hidden until then, or until it changes
  ack ID...     Hide derived rows (list --include-derived) until they change (a new wait,
                plan state or lock holder shows again) or 30 days pass. A question is answered, not acked

Scope (every subcommand; at most one):
  --name WS         The workspace WS instead of the one detected from the current directory
  --project NAME    The project NAME (or a path in it)
  --global          The global list
Without one, add uses the workspace of the current directory, and fails with
not_in_workspace outside any; list reads the workspace, its project and global.

Options (add):
  --type TYPE            todo, alert, note or review_request
  --body TEXT            Longer text, up to 8192 characters
  --body-file PATH|-     Read the body from a file or stdin (64 KB at most)
  --source-kind KIND     jira, github_pr, github_check, session, agent, cli or user
  --source-ref REF       Free text up to 200 characters
  --source-url URL       An https:// URL
  --dedupe-key KEY       Add once: an open or snoozed item with this key in the scope is
                         updated, a resolved one is left alone (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / # @ -, 200 at most)
  --reopen               With --dedupe-key, reopen a resolved item instead of leaving it
  --note REL             A Markdown note that exists in the workspace's notes directory
                         (letters, digits . _ -, at most 4 levels); needs a workspace scope.
                         A notes directory inside the checkout is deleted by finish and kill
  --expires DURATION|ISO After this time the item counts as dismissed and leaves the
                         default list (2h, 2026-10-20T09:00:00Z)
  --link-pane PANE       A tmux pane the item is about
  --link-plan-task ID    A plan task id
  --link-pr N            A pull request number
  --link-run ID          A workflow run id
  --as-user              Record the item as made by a person
  --from-json PATH|-     Take the whole item from one JSON object (64 KB at most) with the keys
                         type, title, body, source, dedupe_key, expires_at, links and scope; use it
                         alone (only --json goes with it)
Options (edit; at least one):
  --title TEXT           A new title
  --body TEXT            A new body ("" clears it); or --body-file PATH|-
  --expires DURATION|ISO A new expiry; --no-expires drops it
  --link-pane PANE, --link-plan-task ID, --link-pr N, --link-run ID
                         Change a link ("" clears it)
Options (done, dismiss):
  --dedupe-key KEY       Resolve the item holding KEY in the scope (no ids); none is unchanged
Options (ack, snooze of derived ids): without a scope flag every workspace and project is read
to find the row.
Options (snooze; one of):
  --until ISO            Wake at this time (2026-10-20T09:00:00Z); it must be in the future
  --for DURATION         Wake after this long from now (30m, 2h)
Options (list):
  --state S[,S]          open (default), snoozed, done, dismissed
  --type TYPE            Only this type
  --all                  Every scope that has items
  --include-derived      Add what needs you now, worked out from workspace state: open
                         questions, waiting agent panes, blocked or stalled plans, workflow
                         gates and stuck locks (open alerts, never stored)
Options (every subcommand):
  --json                 Print the documented JSON (see docs/README.inbox.md)

A title or body with a control character (an escape sequence, NUL) is refused.
Run `workspace inbox VERB --help` for the page of one subcommand.

Examples:
  workspace inbox add "Check the deploy"    # a to-do on this workspace's list
  workspace inbox add "CI failed" --type alert --global    # an alert on the global list
  workspace inbox add --from-json item.json    # take the whole item from a JSON file (- reads stdin)
  workspace inbox list    # open items of this workspace, its project and the global list
  workspace inbox list --all --include-derived --json    # every scope, plus what needs you now, as JSON
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5    # one item, in any state
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title "Check the deploy again"    # change an item
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5 f6a7b8c9d0    # mark several items done
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 --for 2h    # hide an item for two hours
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix    # hide a derived row until it changes
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox add --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox add TITLE [--type TYPE] [--body TEXT | --body-file PATH|-] [options] [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]
       workspace inbox add --from-json PATH|- [--json]

Add an item to the inbox.

Adds a todo unless --type says otherwise, to the workspace of the current directory unless a scope
flag picks another list; outside any workspace that fails with not_in_workspace. It changes the inbox for real.
Titles and bodies are data, never run; one with a control character is refused.

--from-json takes the whole item from one JSON object (64 KB at most) and nothing else but --json.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --type TYPE                  todo (default), alert, note or review_request
    --body TEXT                  Longer text, up to 8192 characters
    --body-file PATH             Read the body from PATH, or - for stdin (64 KB at most)
    --source-kind KIND           jira, github_pr, github_check, session, agent, cli or user
    --source-ref REF             A reference in that source (200 characters at most)
    --source-url URL             An https:// URL
    --dedupe-key KEY             Add once per key and scope: an open or snoozed item with it is updated, a resolved one is left alone
    --reopen                     With --dedupe-key, reopen a resolved item instead of leaving it
    --note REL                   A Markdown note that exists in the workspace's notes directory (needs a workspace scope)
    --expires WHEN               A duration (2h) or an ISO 8601 time; after it the item counts as dismissed
    --link-pane PANE             A tmux pane the item is about
    --link-plan-task ID          A plan task id
    --link-pr N                  A pull request number
    --link-run ID                A workflow run id
    --as-user                    Record the item as made by a person
    --from-json PATH             Read the whole item from a JSON object in PATH, or - for stdin
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox add "Check the deploy"    # a to-do on this workspace's list
  workspace inbox add "CI failed" --type alert --global    # an alert on the global list
  workspace inbox add "Upgrade Rails" --project api    # on a project's list, shared by its worktrees
  workspace inbox add "Check the deploy" --body "Roll back if p95 stays above 2s" --expires 2h    # with longer text, gone after two hours
  workspace inbox add "CI failed" --type alert --source-kind github_check --source-url https://github.com/org/api/actions/runs/1 --global    # record where it came from
  workspace inbox add "Deploy notes ready" --type note --note deploy.md    # point at a note that exists in the notes directory
  workspace inbox add "Review the fix" --link-pr 412 --link-pane %5    # tie it to a pull request and a pane
  workspace inbox add "CI failed" --dedupe-key github_check:org/api:rspec:9f3c2e1 --global    # add once; a repeat updates the open item
  workspace inbox add --from-json item.json    # take the whole item from a JSON file (- reads stdin)
  workspace inbox add "Check the deploy" --json    # read the new item's id in a script
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox list --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox list [--state S[,S]] [--type TYPE] [--all] [--include-derived] [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]

List the items of the inbox.

Without a scope flag: the open items of this workspace, its project and the global list (outside a
workspace, the global list). --all reads every scope that has items, or with --name that workspace, its
project and the global list; --all with --project or --global is refused.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --state S[,S]                open (default), snoozed, done or dismissed; comma-separated
    --type TYPE                  Only items of this type
    --all                        Every scope that has items
    --include-derived            Add what needs you now, worked out from workspace state and never stored: open questions, waiting agent panes, blocked or stalled plans, workflow gates, stuck locks
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of a table
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox list    # open items of this workspace, its project and the global list
  workspace inbox list --state open,snoozed    # snoozed items too
  workspace inbox list --state done    # items already done
  workspace inbox list --type alert    # only alerts
  workspace inbox list --all    # every scope that has items
  workspace inbox list --all --name api    # workspace api, its project and the global list
  workspace inbox list --project api    # one project's list alone
  workspace inbox list --include-derived    # plus what needs you now
  workspace inbox list --all --include-derived --json    # everything, as one JSON document
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox show --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox show ID [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]

Show one item, in any state.

Without a scope flag every scope is searched; an id found in more than one is refused as ambiguous, so pass a scope flag.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5    # search every scope for the id
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5 --global    # look only in the global list
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5 --name api    # look only in workspace api
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5 --json    # one JSON document
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox edit --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox edit ID [--title TEXT] [--body TEXT | --body-file PATH|-] [--expires WHEN | --no-expires] [--link-* VALUE] [--json]

Change an item's title, body, expiry or links.

Works on an item in any state and leaves its state as it is. Pass at least one change; values the item
already holds are reported unchanged. An empty value clears a body or a link. It changes the inbox for real.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --title TEXT                 A new title
    --body TEXT                  A new body; an empty one clears it
    --body-file PATH             Read the body from PATH, or - for stdin (64 KB at most)
    --expires WHEN               A new expiry: a duration (2h) or an ISO 8601 time
    --no-expires                 Drop the expiry
    --link-pane PANE             A tmux pane the item is about; an empty one clears it
    --link-plan-task ID          A plan task id; an empty one clears it
    --link-pr N                  A pull request number; an empty one clears it
    --link-run ID                A workflow run id; an empty one clears it
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title "Check the deploy again"    # rename an item
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body "Roll back if p95 stays above 2s"    # replace its body
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body ""    # clear the body
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body-file notes.txt --global    # take the body from a file, in the global list
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --expires 2h    # expire it in two hours
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --no-expires    # keep it until someone resolves it
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --link-pr 412    # tie it to a pull request
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --link-pr ""    # clear that link
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title "Done soon" --json    # read the result in a script
--- stderr
--- end
### workspace inbox edit --help --json
--- exit 0
--- stdout
{"usage":["workspace inbox edit ID [--title TEXT] [--body TEXT | --body-file PATH|-] [--expires WHEN | --no-expires] [--link-* VALUE] [--json]"],"description":"Change an item's title, body, expiry or links.\n\nWorks on an item in any state and leaves its state as it is. Pass at least one change; values the item\nalready holds are reported unchanged. An empty value clears a body or a link. It changes the inbox for real.","options":[{"flags":"--name NAME","description":"The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory"},{"flags":"--project NAME","description":"The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share"},{"flags":"--global","description":"The global list"},{"flags":"--title TEXT","description":"A new title"},{"flags":"--body TEXT","description":"A new body; an empty one clears it"},{"flags":"--body-file PATH","description":"Read the body from PATH, or - for stdin (64 KB at most)"},{"flags":"--expires WHEN","description":"A new expiry: a duration (2h) or an ISO 8601 time"},{"flags":"--no-expires","description":"Drop the expiry"},{"flags":"--link-pane PANE","description":"A tmux pane the item is about; an empty one clears it"},{"flags":"--link-plan-task ID","description":"A plan task id; an empty one clears it"},{"flags":"--link-pr N","description":"A pull request number; an empty one clears it"},{"flags":"--link-run ID","description":"A workflow run id; an empty one clears it"},{"flags":"--json","description":"Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr"},{"flags":"-h, --help","description":"Show this help"}],"examples":[{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title \"Check the deploy again\"","scenario":"rename an item"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body \"Roll back if p95 stays above 2s\"","scenario":"replace its body"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body \"\"","scenario":"clear the body"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --body-file notes.txt --global","scenario":"take the body from a file, in the global list"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --expires 2h","scenario":"expire it in two hours"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --no-expires","scenario":"keep it until someone resolves it"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --link-pr 412","scenario":"tie it to a pull request"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --link-pr \"\"","scenario":"clear that link"},{"command":"workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title \"Done soon\" --json","scenario":"read the result in a script"}]}

### workspace inbox done --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox done ID... [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]
       workspace inbox done --dedupe-key KEY [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]

Mark items done.

One already done is reported unchanged. Each id is searched in every scope unless a scope flag is given;
exits 0 when every id worked, 3 when some failed, 1 when all did. It changes the inbox for real.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --dedupe-key KEY             Resolve the item holding KEY in the scope (the one `add` uses) instead of ids; none is unchanged
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5    # mark one item done
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5 f6a7b8c9d0    # mark several done
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5 --name api    # look for the id only in workspace api
  workspace inbox done --dedupe-key github_check:org/api:rspec:9f3c2e1 --global    # clear the alert a poster added with that key
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5 --json    # check in a script which ids worked
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox snooze --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox snooze ID... (--until ISO | --for DURATION) [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]

Hide open items until a time.

They read open again after it. A done or dismissed item is refused (reopen it first). A derived id (from
`inbox list --include-derived`) is hidden until then, or until it changes; without a scope flag every
workspace and project is read to find it. It changes the inbox for real.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --until ISO                  Wake at this ISO 8601 time; it must be in the future
    --for DURATION               Wake after this long from now (30m, 2h)
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 --for 2h    # hide an item for two hours
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 f6a7b8c9d0 --for 30m    # hide several
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 --until 2099-01-01T09:00:00Z    # wake at a set time (it must be in the future)
  workspace inbox snooze 'pane:waiting:api.fix:%5' --for 1h    # hide a derived row until then or until it changes
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 --for 2h --json    # check in a script which ids worked
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox ack --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox ack DERIVED_ID... [--name WS | --project NAME | --global] [--json]

Hide derived rows until they change.

Derived rows are the ones `inbox list --include-derived` adds; take their ids from there. An acked row
shows again when it changes (a new wait, plan state or lock holder) or after 30 days. A question is
answered, not acked. Without a scope flag every workspace and project is read to find the row.
It changes the inbox for real.

Options:
    --name NAME                  The workspace NAME instead of the one detected from the current directory
    --project NAME               The project NAME (or a path in it): the list its worktrees share
    --global                     The global list
    --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.inbox.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix    # hide one derived row
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix 'pane:waiting:api.fix:%5'    # hide several
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix --name api    # read only workspace api to find the row
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix --json    # check in a script which rows were hidden
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace inbox
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace inbox add TITLE [options] [scope]
       workspace inbox add --from-json PATH|- [--json]
       workspace inbox done|dismiss --dedupe-key KEY [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox list [--state S[,S]] [--type T] [--all] [--include-derived] [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox show ID [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox edit ID [options] [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox done|dismiss|reopen ID... [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox snooze ID... (--until ISO | --for DURATION) [scope] [--json]
       workspace inbox ack DERIVED_ID... [scope] [--json]

A durable list of things that need a person, kept per workspace, per
project (all worktrees of one repository) or globally. Agents, scripts
and outside tools post to it; titles and bodies are data, never run.

Subcommands:
  add TITLE     Add an item (type todo unless --type says otherwise)
  list          Open items of this workspace, its project and the global list
  show ID       One item, in any state
  edit ID       Change an item's title, body, expiry or links (any state; it stays as it is)
  done ID...    Mark items done; one already done is reported unchanged
  dismiss ID... Mark items dismissed (nobody will act on them)
  reopen ID...  Move done, dismissed or snoozed items back to open
  snooze ID...  Hide open items until a time; they read open again after it. A derived id
                (from list --include-derived) is hidden until then, or until it changes
  ack ID...     Hide derived rows (list --include-derived) until they change (a new wait,
                plan state or lock holder shows again) or 30 days pass. A question is answered, not acked

Scope (every subcommand; at most one):
  --name WS         The workspace WS instead of the one detected from the current directory
  --project NAME    The project NAME (or a path in it)
  --global          The global list
Without one, add uses the workspace of the current directory, and fails with
not_in_workspace outside any; list reads the workspace, its project and global.

Options (add):
  --type TYPE            todo, alert, note or review_request
  --body TEXT            Longer text, up to 8192 characters
  --body-file PATH|-     Read the body from a file or stdin (64 KB at most)
  --source-kind KIND     jira, github_pr, github_check, session, agent, cli or user
  --source-ref REF       Free text up to 200 characters
  --source-url URL       An https:// URL
  --dedupe-key KEY       Add once: an open or snoozed item with this key in the scope is
                         updated, a resolved one is left alone (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / # @ -, 200 at most)
  --reopen               With --dedupe-key, reopen a resolved item instead of leaving it
  --note REL             A Markdown note that exists in the workspace's notes directory
                         (letters, digits . _ -, at most 4 levels); needs a workspace scope.
                         A notes directory inside the checkout is deleted by finish and kill
  --expires DURATION|ISO After this time the item counts as dismissed and leaves the
                         default list (2h, 2026-10-20T09:00:00Z)
  --link-pane PANE       A tmux pane the item is about
  --link-plan-task ID    A plan task id
  --link-pr N            A pull request number
  --link-run ID          A workflow run id
  --as-user              Record the item as made by a person
  --from-json PATH|-     Take the whole item from one JSON object (64 KB at most) with the keys
                         type, title, body, source, dedupe_key, expires_at, links and scope; use it
                         alone (only --json goes with it)
Options (edit; at least one):
  --title TEXT           A new title
  --body TEXT            A new body ("" clears it); or --body-file PATH|-
  --expires DURATION|ISO A new expiry; --no-expires drops it
  --link-pane PANE, --link-plan-task ID, --link-pr N, --link-run ID
                         Change a link ("" clears it)
Options (done, dismiss):
  --dedupe-key KEY       Resolve the item holding KEY in the scope (no ids); none is unchanged
Options (ack, snooze of derived ids): without a scope flag every workspace and project is read
to find the row.
Options (snooze; one of):
  --until ISO            Wake at this time (2026-10-20T09:00:00Z); it must be in the future
  --for DURATION         Wake after this long from now (30m, 2h)
Options (list):
  --state S[,S]          open (default), snoozed, done, dismissed
  --type TYPE            Only this type
  --all                  Every scope that has items
  --include-derived      Add what needs you now, worked out from workspace state: open
                         questions, waiting agent panes, blocked or stalled plans, workflow
                         gates and stuck locks (open alerts, never stored)
Options (every subcommand):
  --json                 Print the documented JSON (see docs/README.inbox.md)

A title or body with a control character (an escape sequence, NUL) is refused.
Run `workspace inbox VERB --help` for the page of one subcommand.

Examples:
  workspace inbox add "Check the deploy"    # a to-do on this workspace's list
  workspace inbox add "CI failed" --type alert --global    # an alert on the global list
  workspace inbox add --from-json item.json    # take the whole item from a JSON file (- reads stdin)
  workspace inbox list    # open items of this workspace, its project and the global list
  workspace inbox list --all --include-derived --json    # every scope, plus what needs you now, as JSON
  workspace inbox show a1b2c3d4e5    # one item, in any state
  workspace inbox edit a1b2c3d4e5 --title "Check the deploy again"    # change an item
  workspace inbox done a1b2c3d4e5 f6a7b8c9d0    # mark several items done
  workspace inbox snooze a1b2c3d4e5 --for 2h    # hide an item for two hours
  workspace inbox ack plan:blocked:api.fix    # hide a derived row until it changes
--- stderr
--- end
